d: What triggered the political earthquake in America? Donald Trump and the Republicans face a major setback as Democrats make sweeping gains in the US Midterm Elections 2026. From rising inflation, the cost-of-living crisis and the Iran war to Republican losses in Texas and Ohio, this special report examines the issues that shaped the election. It also explores the growing influence of Indian Americans in US politics, the election of Indian American candidates, and Vivek Ramaswamy's defeat in Ohio.
